set.body:
Purpose
Migrate reframe4s from the pre-repair image4s geometry surface to explicit persistent keys and precise frame owners. A local downstream court on 2026-07-30 found 22 JVM/Scala.js compile errors: total frame/grid .id assumptions and widened-owner Point.fromVector[D,F] calls.

Acceptance criteria
- Persistent frame/grid identity is obtained through checked records or persistent keys; ephemeral geometry is handled explicitly.
- Same-owner point construction uses precise inferred owners; erased/deserialized owners use checked alignment/rebind evidence.
- No throwing compatibility accessor or fabricated ID is added to image4s.
- reframe4s JVM and Scala.js compile and test against the exact image4s revision under review.
- reframe4s updates its immutable image4s pin only after image4s is committed and available from a clean checkout.

Tests
- Negative compile tests preserve owner separation.
- Persistent restore and live-owner divergence cases.
- Complete reframe4s JVM/Scala.js test court with local source override.
- Fresh-checkout court against the pinned image4s commit.
set.title: Migrate reframe4s to explicit image4s persistent identity and precise owners
